verses.pali: “Assutavā, bhikkhave, puthujjano rūpassa assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, an unlearned ordinary person doesn’t truly understand the gratification, the drawback, and the escape when it comes to form,

verses.pali: viññāṇassa assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.
Sutavā ca kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako rūpassa assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: A learned noble disciple does truly understand the gratification, the drawback, and the escape when it comes to form,

verses.pali: viññāṇassa assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ pajānātī”ti.
